invariants.title: Generated element inventory is exhaustive for the current vendored index
invariants.statement: The current model exposes 142 generated HTML element members, including 29 obsolete members, with stable literal tags.

enforcement.validator: @beep/html Effect Schema decode boundary for html.inventory.generated-elements

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.inventory.generated-elements

invariants.title: Approved source refresh is not yet the consumed generator corpus
invariants.statement: Conformance against the approved WHATWG and webref refresh cannot be claimed until the approved bytes are vendored, regenerated, and reviewed; the model currently consumes older webref and dated derived-index bytes.

enforcement.gap: The current pinned evidence cannot establish exhaustive conformance for this invariant.

invariants.title: Every public node variant has a stable literal discriminator
invariants.statement: Generated elements and auxiliary nodes use literal _tag values and existing public unions are exhaustively discriminated by _tag.

enforcement.validator: @beep/html Effect Schema decode boundary for html.ast.literal-tag-discrimination

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.ast.literal-tag-discrimination

invariants.title: Element-local child schemas should reject impossible child categories
invariants.statement: Most generated element classes currently admit broad HtmlChildren at type and decode boundaries; content categories and contextual grammars are applied later by inspectConformance.

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.element.local-content-model

invariants.title: Heading elements must contain only permitted phrasing content
invariants.statement: H1 through H6 retain broad HtmlChildren at the local schema boundary, while inspectConformance rejects nested heading descendants through the generated phrasing-only content model.

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.heading.phrasing-children

invariants.title: Computed heading levels must apply offsets, reset boundaries, and the level-nine cap
invariants.statement: computeHeadingOutline applies inherited headingoffset values, resets the inherited offset at headingreset boundaries, and caps computed heading levels at nine.

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.heading.computed-levels

invariants.title: Computed heading levels must not skip a level in tree order
invariants.statement: inspectConformance emits a headingOutline error when a computed heading level increases by more than one relative to the preceding heading in tree order.

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.heading.no-skipped-levels

invariants.title: A heading outline should contain at least one computed level-one heading
invariants.statement: Missing computed level-one headings do not fail inspectConformance; inspectBestPractices reports the separate headingLevelOne advisory.

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.heading.level-one-advisory

invariants.title: A canonical HTML document has valid doctype and document-element structure
invariants.statement: The canonical document boundary narrows direct children, while conform checks doctype placement, document element cardinality, and root placement.

enforcement.validator: @beep/html Effect Schema decode boundary for html.document.structure

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.document.structure

invariants.title: Context-sensitive element child sequences must satisfy reviewed grammars
invariants.statement: The generated conformance registry applies reviewed child-sequence and contextual grammars that cannot be represented by one local array schema.

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.content.special-child-grammars

invariants.title: Conditional required, forbidden, and value-constrained attributes must be enforced
invariants.statement: Generated schemas enforce local value domains and inspectConformance enforces contextual attribute requirements and exclusions.

enforcement.validator: @beep/html Effect Schema decode boundary for html.attributes.conditional-requirements

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.attributes.conditional-requirements

invariants.title: Input attributes must be valid for the effective input state
invariants.statement: The current flat Input model decodes finite type values and the tree validator applies the reviewed 22-state attribute applicability table.

enforcement.validator: @beep/html Effect Schema decode boundary for html.attributes.input-state-applicability

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.attributes.input-state-applicability

invariants.title: Script type values must resolve to an author-conforming semantic state
invariants.statement: ScriptState classifies missing, empty, JavaScript MIME essence-match, module, import-map, speculation-rules, and valid data-block type values while preserving Script.type; invalid non-special strings produce typed failures and conformance diagnostics.

enforcement.oracle: Pinned WHATWG HTML and MIME Sniffing script type algorithms

invariants.title: Script attributes must be valid for the effective type and inline or external context
invariants.statement: inspectConformance exhaustively applies the WHATWG classic, module, import-map, speculation-rules, and data-block attribute matrix, including that src is limited to classic and module scripts and data blocks remain inline.

enforcement.oracle: Pinned WHATWG script attribute applicability table

invariants.title: Inline script payloads must conform to their selected language or data format
invariants.statement: The AST retains script content losslessly, but the package does not parse JavaScript, module, import-map, speculation-rules, script-documentation, or arbitrary data-block MIME payload languages and therefore cannot establish their language-level validity.

enforcement.gap: Payload-language conformance requires language-specific parsers or profile adapters that are outside the structural HTML AST validator.

invariants.title: Finite keywords, booleans, numbers, token lists, and case rules must decode canonically
invariants.statement: Generated and hand-authored attribute schemas enforce finite keyword, presence-boolean, numeric, token-list, and ASCII-case fixed points where modeled.

enforcement.validator: @beep/html Effect Schema decode boundary for html.attributes.microsyntaxes

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.attributes.microsyntaxes

invariants.title: Cross-attribute numeric relationships must hold
invariants.statement: Generated relationship records enforce ordering, defaults, and bounded domains that span multiple attributes.

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.attributes.numeric-relationships

invariants.title: IDs must be unique and constrained references must resolve in the required scope
invariants.statement: The tree validator reports duplicate IDs and validates configured single and list ID references with case-sensitive scope rules.

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.document.unique-ids-and-references

invariants.title: Subtitle track srclang values must use registered and structurally valid language tags
invariants.statement: The generator verifies the IANA registry digest and emits the tables used by conditional srclang validation, including extlang prefix constraints.

enforcement.validator: @beep/html Effect Schema decode boundary for html.track.language-tags

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.track.language-tags

invariants.title: Responsive image srcset syntax and descriptor relationships must be valid
invariants.statement: The package parses srcset candidates, validates descriptors and URLs, and applies element-context relationships.

enforcement.validator: @beep/html Effect Schema decode boundary for html.responsive.srcset

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.responsive.srcset

invariants.title: Responsive image source-size lists must satisfy the supported WHATWG and CSS grammar
invariants.statement: The source-size analyzer validates supported lengths, math functions, media conditions, auto placement, and contextual responsive-image relationships.

enforcement.validator: @beep/html Effect Schema decode boundary for html.responsive.sizes

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.responsive.sizes

invariants.title: Foreign element and qualified attribute names must obey namespace and adjustment rules
invariants.statement: The package validates SVG, MathML, XML, XMLNS, and XLink name adjustments and requires compatible foreign integration context.

enforcement.validator: @beep/html Effect Schema decode boundary for html.foreign.names-and-namespaces

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.foreign.names-and-namespaces

invariants.title: Text, comment, raw-text, RCDATA, plaintext, and void serialization must be deterministic and safe
invariants.statement: Serialization applies context-specific escaping, deterministic attribute order, void handling, and raw end-tag hazard checks.

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.serialization.text-modes

invariants.title: The safe profile must reject active content and unsafe attributes
invariants.statement: SafeHtml narrows the broad structural AST by denying active, event, style, form, foreign, and unsafe URL surfaces and by issuing an opaque conformance proof.

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.safe-profile.active-content

invariants.title: ARIA roles and element-specific role compatibility must be checked
invariants.statement: The conformance pass checks configured role compatibility and element-aware ARIA rules; it does not claim exhaustive accessibility conformance.

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.aria.role-compatibility

invariants.title: Obsolete elements must remain losslessly decodable but be reported as non-conforming
invariants.statement: The broad AST retains obsolete element wires for compatibility, while conformance metadata marks them non-conforming.

enforcement.oracle: Pinned source rule and package expectation for html.obsolete.nonconforming-elements

invariants.title: Every generated or reviewed rule should cite an immutable source anchor
invariants.statement: Current reviewed classification entries and generated element docs do not carry stable per-rule source IDs and anchors, so exhaustive semantic traceability is not yet proven.

enforcement.gap: The current pinned evidence cannot establish exhaustive conformance for this invariant.

invariants.title: HTML source parsing and browser tree repair are outside the AST profile
invariants.statement: The package validates already-constructed AST values and does not claim to tokenize arbitrary HTML source or reproduce browser error recovery.

enforcement.gap: The package does not implement the required profile boundary.

invariants.title: Arbitrary custom elements are outside the generated standard-element union
invariants.statement: HtmlNode is exhaustive for the pinned standard and obsolete element inventory; arbitrary autonomous custom HTML element classes are not modeled as first-class generated members.

enforcement.gap: The package does not implement the required profile boundary.
